g.text: Terms: CF1, CF2 … = causal factor in a hazard record (CF1, CF2 …) · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure
search · FLT-nnn = walker fault in sim/faults.yaml · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family (sim/search) · SZ-nnn = actuator
sizing study at level 2 (sim/mujoco/sizing.yaml) · TS-nnn = architecture trade study
